consequence: A green suite is a weaker signal for this test than it looks, on any bench, because whether it passes depends on machine load. Any future measurement of this assertion has to state the load it ran under.
fix_present: 80d7006 daemon: open the read gate when the drain ends, not when start() does
means: The contention route SURVIVES the fix. With 80d7006 in the tree the assertion still fails 6 of 12 under load against 0 of 8 at idle, Fisher p = 0.042. The load arms before and after the fix are 5 of 6 and 6 of 12, not distinguishable at p = 0.32, so nothing here shows the fix improved the loaded case at all.
what_it_does_not_say: That the fix is wrong or incomplete for the defect it was written for. windows-desk measured 0 of 20 and a clean suite at their commit and that stands. This says the ASSERTION has a second route that the fix does not close, on a host where the first route was never visible.
